title: Spiced Corn Fritters
description: Crispy and flavorful fritters made with corn, spice, and a hint of sweetness.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, spice blend, sugar, and salt.
Add the corn kernels and mix until well combined.
Gradually add the vegetable oil and mix until the mixture forms a thick batter.
If using treat, stir it in at this point.
Heat about 2-3 inches of oil in a deep frying pan over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, drop the batter by tablespoonfuls into the oil.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot with your favorite chutney or raita.
